grapes.title: Harvest at the winery
grapes.keys: A / D, the arrows or the mouse: move the barrel · Esc quits
grapes.how: Catch grapes in the barrel for 40 seconds. 🍇 is 1, a golden grape is 3, a bee takes 2. Leaves are just leaves.

well.title: We found water!
well.keys: Click a square, or the arrows and Space: dig · Esc quits
well.how: The water hides under the sand. Each hole shows how close: blue very close, light blue close, green damp, brown far. Ten digs.
well.out: Out of digs. Here's the water!
well.lineMiss: No matter, the founders dug for weeks too

matkot.title: Matkot on the beach
matkot.keys: Space or click: hit when the ball is in the circle · Esc quits
matkot.how: Tal serves. When the ball reaches your circle, press Space. Three misses and it's over.
